idea-plugin.name: Font Preview
idea-plugin.change-notes: Hide unavailable copy actions in the context menu. Keep Copy Glyph ID and Inspect Glyph available for every glyph.
idea-plugin.description:
Preview font repertoires in a native IntelliJ editor, with no browser runtime.

TTF, OTF, TTC, OTC and WOFF support. Resize glyphs, inspect font metadata, switch collection faces, and copy characters, Unicode escapes or U+ notation.
